text: Festus Missouri scenario Table 3.18 lists factors of modeled centerline concentrations to the median values for the Festus, Missouri accident from Table 3.14. EPIcode centerline concentrations were very consistent with the median values near the source, 1.1–1.3 up to 0.5 km. Further downwind, from 1.0 km and beyond, EPIcode’s factors increase with distance to a range of 1.8–4.1.This is contrary to the concentration factors for the Macdona, Texas scenario from Table 3.16 with higher factors closer to the source followed by improved factors further downwind. These differing trends against the same group of models supports a lack of a system bias within the EPIcode algorithm. Table 3.18. As was done in Table 3.17, the single model prediction resulting in the median value is identified as a “1”. EPIcode results for plume width are consistent, all higher than the median in the range 1.6–1.7. The model generating the median value is identified for both the width and height predictions. Factors for EPIcode’s height predictions, 1.4–2.1, were a mix of lower and higher values compared to the medians. The factor at a target concentration of 2,000, closest to the source, was EPIcode’s highest among its own for width or height. The trend at all three target concentrations is encouraging as it nears the median value and it crosses over from a lower to a higher value (Low 1.4 at 400 ppm to High 1.4 at 20 ppm), another example of no apparent systemic bias.
